text.name: Default text color which comply with W3C standards, and this color is also the darkest neutral color.
The second level of text color is generally used in scenarios where text color is not emphasized, such as label text, menu text selection state, etc.
The third level of text color is generally used for descriptive text, such as form supplementary explanation text, list descriptive text, etc.
The fourth level of text color is the lightest text color, such as form input prompt text, disabled color text, etc.
Control the highlight color of text with background color, such as the text in Primary Button components.
Control the font color of heading.
Control the font color of text label.
Control the font color of text description.
Control the color of text in disabled state.
Control the color of placeholder text.
Control the color of the icons.
Control the color of the icons when hovering.
Container background color, e.g: Section, Default Button, Input, etc.
Container background color of the popup layer. E.g: Modal, Popup, Menu, etc.
This color is used for the low level background color of the overall layout of the page.
Used to cover the content below the mask in Modal and Drawer components.
This color is used to draw the user's strong attention to the background color, and is currently only used in the background color of Tooltip.
Control the background color of container in disabled state.
Control the background color of text in active state.
Control the background color of text in hover state.
Control the color of background border of element.
Default border color, used to separate different elements, such as: form separator, card separator, etc.
Slightly lighter than the default border color, this color is the same as `colorSplit`. Solid color is used.
Used as the color of separator, this color is the same as colorBorderSecondary but with transparency.
Control the alternative background color of element.

The second level of fill color can outline the shape of the element more clearly, such as Rate, Skeleton, etc. It can also be used as the Hover state of the third level of fill color, such as Table, etc.

The third level of fill color is used to outline the shape of the element, such as Slider, Segmented, etc. If there is no emphasis requirement, it is recommended to use the third level of fill color as the default fill color.
The weakest level of fill color is suitable for color blocks that are not easy to attract attention, such as zebra stripes, color blocks that distinguish boundaries, etc.
Control the background color of content area.
Control the style of background color of content area when mouse hovers over it.
Control the alternative background color of element.
Used in border radius of cards and images
Used in the subscribe to newsletter form
